author.name: Vishal Hingol
author.bio: Vishal Hingol is a mindset author, corporate professional, and lifelong student of personal transformation. Born and raised in Surat, Gujarat, with over 14 years of experience in the digital print media industry, he combines practical real-world experience with spiritual wisdom to create actionable tools that help readers shift their mindset, break limiting patterns, and consciously design a life of abundance, clarity, and fulfilment.

books.title: Digital Sovereignty
books.subtitle: Breaking Free from Modern Traps, Reclaiming Your Mind, and Winning the Game of Life
books.description: The system profits when you obey. You win when you think. A practical manual for men who refuse to be programmed — covering algorithms that hijack your attention, social media that owns your mind, money myths that keep you broke, fake identities that steal your self, and constant distraction that kills your depth. Escape the traps. Reclaim your attention, finances, identity, relationships, and purpose.

books.title: Zara and the Divine Signal
books.subtitle: When the Universe Chooses a Child to Change the World
books.description: Vishal's most ambitious work to date: a complete human journey told through one person over twenty-three years — a girl, an old radio, and a signal that should not exist. Not instruction, but lived experience: how the signal works, what the noise costs, and what becomes possible when you choose, consistently and without apology, to transmit what you actually are.

books.title: Why You Keep Holding Yourself Back
books.subtitle: Break Self-Sabotage, Rewire Your Mind, and Finally Move Forward
books.description: You know what to do. You've set your goals. You've made the plans. And yet you keep ending up in the same place — not because you're lazy or lack discipline, but because subconscious beliefs, childhood conditioning, comfort zone addiction and fear of success are silently controlling your decisions. A practical, science-backed guide to permanently breaking the pattern. This is not a motivational book. Understanding creates permanent change.

books.title: The Unconditioned Mind
books.subtitle: How to Dissolve Modern Traps, Reclaim Your Focus, and Awaken Your True Potential
books.description: Reclaim your focus. Rewire your mind. Break free. A science-backed path to sovereign awareness in an age of distraction — breaking compulsive behaviours, rebuilding deep focus, reclaiming emotional clarity, escaping digital conditioning, and cultivating the kind of awareness that puts you back in control of your own mind.

books.title: The Universe is Whispering to You
books.subtitle: How to Recognize Signs, Decode Synchronicities, and Listen to the Messages from the Other Side
books.description: For everyone who has experienced something they can't explain — and can't tell anyone about. A guide to noticing the signs and synchronicities woven through everyday life: the 111s, the 222s, the feathers, the doors. Learn to trust what they're telling you. The universe has been speaking all along.

books.title: The Run-Your-Business-On-AI Playbook
books.subtitle: How Small Business Owners Use ChatGPT, Claude, and Canva to Reclaim 20 Hours a Week
books.description: Stop doing the work of three people. Let AI do it instead. No theory, no future predictions — every page answers one question: how do I get AI to do this specific task right now, today? A hands-on playbook using ChatGPT, Claude and Canva to automate emails, content, reports, schedules and reviews. Ranked #7 in Two-Hour Business Short Reads.

books.title: Lucky Girl Evidence Journal
books.subtitle: A 90-Day Guided Program to Rewire Your Brain, Track Your Wins, and Attract Lasting Abundance
books.description: What if feeling lucky isn't random — but something you can learn to recognize and build over time? This 90-day guided journal helps you shift your focus toward what's working, track meaningful progress, and develop a more positive daily mindset. Based on neuroscience, identity work and the law of assumption: I am lucky. I attract. I receive. I allow. I become.

books.title: Your Mind Is the Blueprint
books.subtitle: Rewire Your Thinking, Break Hidden Patterns, and Design the Life You Actually Want
books.description: Change your mind. Change your life. Most people try to change their life by changing what they do — and fail. This book targets the one factor that shapes every decision, habit and outcome: your thinking patterns. Understand your mind, rewire your patterns, redesign your life. A practical starting point for anyone ready to move forward with more clarity.

books.title: The Divine 3-6-9 Manifestation Method
books.subtitle: A Practical Guide to Attract Love, Money, Self-Love, and Abundance Using the 369 Technique
books.description: A complete, structured guide to the 369 writing practice — 3 times in the morning, 6 in the afternoon, 9 at night — grounded in how repetition actually rewires belief. Covers love, money, self-love and abundance. Ranked #31 in Motivational Self-Help and #31 in Success eBooks on Amazon Kindle.

books.title: The Quiet Revolution
books.subtitle: How to Manifest the Life You Want Without Lying to Yourself
books.description: A radically honest approach to transformation — no fake positivity, no magical thinking, no spiritual performance. Blending psychology, neuroscience, behavioural change, emotional awareness, and practical daily action, this book strips away surface-level advice and builds something real. If you're ready to stop chasing shortcuts and start building a foundation, this is where to begin.

books.title: The AI-First Competitor
books.subtitle: How Local Businesses and Solo Founders Weaponize Next-Gen AI Workflows to Reclaim Time and Dominate Competitors
books.description: Work smarter. Automate. Scale. Win. The businesses winning right now aren't bigger — they're faster, smarter and better organised. Respond to leads in 5 minutes flat, build your private knowledge base, automate invoices, run AI agents that work 24/7. Includes a 30-day roadmap from overwhelmed to fully operational. Your competitors aren't waiting. Neither should you.

books.title: Unshackled
books.subtitle: 12 Hidden Habits Keeping Modern Men Stagnant, Lonely, and Broke — and How to Break Free
books.description: The habits that saved you then are silently destroying you now. Twelve hidden patterns keeping modern men stagnant, lonely, and broke: dopamine distractions, the lone wolf myth, the alpha caricature, overthinking paralysis, emotional disconnection, financial illiteracy, comfort addiction, external validation, poor time discipline, weak environment, lack of direction, and instant gratification. Named, explained, and dismantled. This is not motivation. This is rewiring.

books.title: The Real Architect of Echoes
books.subtitle: The Story of Changing Your Frequency
books.description: Reality is not random. It's responding. A story about the echoes we send into the world, the ones that return, and the moment a man realizes he has been the architect of both all along. When you change your frequency, you change everything that comes back to you.

books.title: The Real Frequency of Origins
books.subtitle: A Novel — When the Universe Starts Talking Back
books.description: NO SIGNAL. RETRYING… In a city drowning in noise, one woman starts receiving answers to questions she never asked aloud. A novel about origins, signals, and what happens when the universe finally talks back to someone who has spent a lifetime broadcasting into silence.

books.title: The Signal
books.subtitle: A 21-Day Protocol for Rewiring Your Attention, Reclaiming Your Mind, and Tuning Into the Frequency of Everything You Want
books.description: Cut through the noise. Tune into what matters. A focused 21-day protocol for rewiring your attention, reclaiming your mind, and locking onto the frequency of the life you actually want. Day by day, the interference clears. Day by day, the signal gets stronger.

books.title: Your Life Is Speaking — Are You Listening?
books.subtitle: How to Hear the Signals, Break the Patterns, and Live with Clarity
books.description: Your life is already speaking — through repetition, resistance, and the things you keep avoiding. Every pattern that won't break, every door that keeps closing, every restlessness you can't name is a signal. A practical guide to hearing what your life is saying, breaking the patterns, and finally living with clarity.

books.title: The Great Alignment Principle
books.subtitle: How to Stop Forcing Life and Start Aligning With the Natural Flow of Success, Peace, and Abundance
books.description: Forcing creates friction; alignment creates flow. This book shows you how to stop white-knuckling your way through life and start moving with the natural current of success, peace, and abundance that is already available to you — the moment you stop fighting it.

books.title: Activate Your Silent Mind
books.subtitle: Clearing the Interference Between You and the Life the Signal Is Offering
books.description: Beneath the noise of thought, comparison and constant input, there is a silent mind — clear, steady, already tuned. This book is about activating it: quieting the interference so the signal you were born with can finally come through and you can receive the life that has been waiting for you.
